payload.rationale: This document is a Phase 2 E2E test reproducing the missing-id failure pattern — a markdown heading submitted without an explicit id field, requiring the pipeline to produce a valid slug and commit without crashing. The graph contains exactly one position (Position_MemoryPipelineIdentifierResolution) and one narrative (Narrative_DeterministicIdentifierFallbackEnsuresIngestionContinuity) that frame this precise scenario, both witnessed 2026-09-14 from the same sample memory. Their two member expressions — the claim that no id was submitted and the decision that the pipeline must slugify and commit — are the load-bearing context the extraction passes need to bind this document to existing graph content rather than minting duplicates. The actor (Xena ExpertGH) is expanded to complete provenance. No thematic areas or dimensions exist in this graph, and the ^Thematic door returned zero areas, so there is nothing else to expand.
